name: Sujay Mahadik
blurb: An engineer who keeps a design studio in his pocket, and an economist who reads philosophy in the margins.
longBio: By trade I'm an SRE at Barclays in UK, building observability for Infrastructure — Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Elastic, real-time alarm shipping.
I co-founded two small studios — Infin8y Labs and The Jellyfish Collective.
Bachelor of Engineering in IT and a Masters in Economics. I think a lot about justice as a measurable concept.

education.description: Post-graduate study in economics with a focus on justice, measurement, and political economy.
notes: Coursework in welfare theory, institutional economics, and social choice
Shaped ongoing thinking on justice as a measurable concept

education.description: Undergraduate engineering degree, graduating in the top 3% of the cohort while running two student ventures.
notes: Published research on distributed systems in IJSER (2019)
Co-founded Infin8y Labs and led MIT CREON alongside studies
